description: This PHP class defines an EmployeeAddress data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM system to represent employee address details, including street, city, province, zipcode, and country. It implements the Stringable interface for string conversion and uses traits and external entity classes.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an employee's address details with methods for string serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EmployeeAddress instance with address components such as street, city, province, zipcode, and country.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the address object to a formatted string, fetching the country name if a country code is provided.
